Emraan Hashmi returns as 'Awarapan 2' character in new teaser

The teaser for the upcoming film 'Awarapan 2' has been released, marking the return of actor Emraan Hashmi in his role as Shivam Pandit. The film is a sequel to the 2007 movie 'Awarapan'. The teaser features Hashmi as an emotionally scarred lover and also includes Disha Patani and Shabana Azmi. The film is directed by Nitin Kakkar.
